newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA SPOORNET TO LINK UP WITH PVT SECTOR - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA SPOORNET TO LINK UP WITH PVT SECTOR - REPORT.

text.p: South African transportation parastatal Transnet's rail subsidiary Spoornet would announce a broad restructuring on Friday, focusing on a management reshuffle and opening its operations to the private sector, Business Day newspaper reported.

The paper quoted analysts saying that full-scale privatisation had been ruled out. However, the parastatal was likely to promote partnerships, joint ventures and alliances with the private sector to further its goal of becoming a fully market-driven company.
Major management changes were also on the cards, with Spoornet's regional management structure set to disappear and up to 30 new black managers to be employed at Spoornet's head office.
Executive director Mafike Makwanazi has warned that significant downsizing would take place at Spoornet, which employs 54,000 of Transnet's 96,800 workers.
He said retrenchments would be across the board but would focus on management. Up to 40 percent of the new staff structure would be black or women.
